languages.en: Happy Raksha Bandhan, brother! Thanks for always being my superhero, even without a cape. This Rakhi comes with unlimited love and zero complaints.
languages.hi: रक्षाबंधन की शुभकामनाएँ, भाई! आप हमेशा मेरे सुपरहीरो रहे हैं, बिना केप के। यह राखी असीमित प्यार और शिकायतों के साथ आती है।
languages.hinglish: Happy Raksha Bandhan, bhai! Thanks hamesha mere superhero banne ke liye, bina cape ke. Ye Rakhi unlimited pyaar aur zero shikayat ke saath aayi hai.

altText.en: Raksha Bandhan greeting card for brother: Happy Raksha Bandhan, brother! Thanks for always being my superhero, even without a cape. This Rakhi comes with unlimited love and zero complaints.
